products.overview: Labs need pure and ultrapure water at more than one bench. The Sartorius Arium Smart Station dispenses the exact quantities you need, where and when you need them: up to 3 stations per ultrapure system, up to 4 m between units. Flow runs splash-free from drop-by-drop to 2.0 L/min, volume-controlled from 50 mL to 50 L, with a 4.3 inch touch screen, a height-adjustable arm and data transfer to an ELN, web service or USB-C.

faqs.question: What is the Sartorius Arium Smart Station?
faqs.answer: The Arium Smart Station is a water dispensing system for pure and ultrapure water. It dispenses the quantities needed for experiments at multiple points in the lab, bench-top or wall-mounted.

faqs.question: Which Arium systems does the Arium Smart Station connect to?
faqs.answer: The Ultrapure edition connects to Arium Pro or Arium Comfort systems for Type 1 water. The Pure edition connects to an Arium Bagtank.

faqs.question: How many Smart Stations can connect to one system?
faqs.answer: Up to 3 Smart Stations can connect to one ultrapure system, with up to 4 m between units.

faqs.question: What is the flow rate of the Arium Smart Station?
faqs.answer: Up to 2.0 L/min, adjustable and splash-free from drop-by-drop. Flow rate depends on inlet pressure and system type.

faqs.question: What volumes can the Arium Smart Station dispense automatically?
faqs.answer: Volume-controlled dispensing covers 50 mL to 50 L, with predefined favorite volumes for recurring tasks.

faqs.question: Can the Arium Smart Station be used left-handed?
faqs.answer: Yes. Both bench-top and wall-mounted versions switch between left- and right-hand use without extra accessories.

faqs.question: How does the Arium Smart Station document water use?
faqs.answer: Data goes to an ELN, is available through a web service on the local network, or transfers to a computer via USB-C.

faqs.question: Which final filters fit the Arium Smart Station?
faqs.answer: The Arium Sterile Plus filter (0.45 + 0.2 µm) for sterile applications and the Arium Cell Plus ultrafilter (15 kDa) for life science and cell culture.

faqs.question: What is the price of the Arium® Smart Station in India?
faqs.answer: Pricing depends on the configuration and options. Contact Inkarp for a quotation on +91 8125580808 or info@inkarp.co.in.

faqs.question: Who is the authorized distributor for the Arium Smart Station in India?
faqs.answer: Inkarp is the authorized distributor and service provider for the Sartorius Arium Smart Station in India, with support for installation, training, AMC and application support.

sections.glanceTitle: Arium Smart Station at a Glance
sections.glanceDescription: Everything you need to evaluate the Arium Smart Station, including editions, compatible systems, dispensing modes, data documentation and final filters.
intro: The overview of the Arium Smart Station covers its role in dispensing pure and ultrapure water at multiple points in the lab.

The Arium Smart Station Ultrapure dispenses Type 1 water from an Arium Pro or Arium Comfort system. The Arium Smart Station Pure dispenses pure water from an Arium Bagtank. Both are available bench-top or wall-mounted.

A small footprint, a height-adjustable arm and a magnetically attached handheld let users fill containers of different sizes at multiple points in the lab, with control over water quality at the point of use.

body.text: Bench-top or wall-mounted; left- or right-hand use without extra accessories.
Up to 3 Smart Stations per ultrapure system, up to 4 m between units.
Flow from drop-by-drop up to 2.0 L/min, splash-free.
Manual, volume-controlled (50 mL to 50 L) and favorite-volume dispensing.
4.3 inch touch-activated color display, usable with gloves.
Data documentation via ELN, web service or USB-C.

sections.title: The point-of-use water dispensing workflow
sections.description: How the Arium Smart Station works, in a continuous loop of connect, select, position, dispense and document.

steps.title: Connect
steps.description: The Ultrapure edition connects to an Arium Pro or Arium Comfort system; the Pure edition to an Arium Bagtank, with 2 m tubing or up to 4 m with the extension set.

steps.title: Select Mode
steps.description: Manual, volume-controlled (50 mL to 50 L) or a favorite volume is chosen on the 4.3 inch touch display.

steps.title: Position
steps.description: The dispenser arm is set from 8.5 to 65 cm and rotated, or the magnetically attached handheld is used.

steps.title: Dispense
steps.description: Water flows splash-free from drop-by-drop up to 2.0 L/min, with soft start and stop, through an optional final filter.

steps.title: Document
steps.description: Dispensed volumes and water quality data go to an ELN, the web service or a computer via USB-C.
